tools.name: facturisonline_list_products
tools.description: List products from the Facturis product catalogue (Nomenclatorul de Produse). With no filter it returns all products. To find one product, give both search_field (for example prod_cod for the EAN barcode, or prod_sku) and search_value. API: POST met=Produse act=Get.

tools.name: facturisonline_get_stock
tools.description: Get the stock card for a warehouse (gestiune) at a location (punct de lucru), as Facturis returns it. Both names must match the names set in the account, for example SEDIUL SOCIAL and gestiune principala. API: POST met=Stoc act=Get.

tools.name: facturisonline_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (Clienti) of the company: name, fiscal code, registration number, address, phone and id. The API returns all clients in one reply, so large accounts give a long reply. API: POST met=Clienti act=Get.

tools.name: facturisonline_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices issued in a date range, as Facturis returns them. Dates use dd-mm-yyyy. API: POST met=Facturi act=Get with date_start and date_stop.

tools.name: facturisonline_create_client
tools.description: Create a client in the Facturis client list. Facturis rejects a client that already exists with the same name, fiscal code and registration number, so a repeat call does not add a second client. The required fields depend on the account settings; Facturis names a missing field in its error. API: POS

tools.name: facturisonline_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a live invoice in the customer's Facturis account. Facturis numbers it (series and number are automatic) and sets it to status Emisa (issued). Each line's totals are computed here from the net unit price, quantity and VAT rate. The call is sent once and is not retried. API: POST met=Facturi a

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facturisonline_list_products, facturisonline_get_stock, facturisonline_list_clients, facturisonline_list_invoices, facturisonline_create_client · Public sink: facturisonline_list_products, facturisonline_get_stock, facturisonline_list_clients, facturisonline_list_invoices, facturisonline_create_client, facturisonline_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facturisonline_list_products, facturisonline_get_stock, facturisonline_list_clients, facturisonline_list_invoices, facturisonline_create_client · Public sink: facturisonline_list_products, facturisonline_get_stock, facturisonline_list_clients, facturisonline_list_invoices, facturisonline_create_client, facturisonline_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
